description: core §7.5, a heartbeat's collections. Written by an independent reading of the text (Python, standard library), checked, never blessed. `contracts` holds each revision's authoring text. `layouts`: a revision → its fingerprint, the heartbeat's tag (the low four bits of the fingerprint's last byte), and its collections in map order: each `state` or `@state` resource whose resolved `freshness.ttl_s` is above 0, by kind token then template, with its `cardinality` (`null` for a template with no parameter, one member), the width of its live count, ⌈log₂(cardinality + 1)⌉ bits (`null` with one member), and its horizon. A stream, a horizon of 0 and no horizon make no collection.

contracts.bare.v1:
# core §7.5's heartbeat: a revision with no collection, so a body is its
# time alone.
[interface]
name  = "bare"
major = 1
minor = 0

[resources.note]
kind = "state"
type = { raw = "text/plain" }

[resources.level]
kind = "stream"
type = { raw = "text/plain" }
contracts.alert.v1:
# core §7.5's owner heartbeat: W2's alarms.v1 in shape, one templated
# collection, self-contained.
[interface]
name  = "alert"
major = 1
minor = 0
uses  = ["freshness.v2"]

[resources."alarms/{alert_key}"]     # templated: at most 256 live, 9 bits
kind        = "state"
type        = { raw = "text/plain" }
params      = { alert_key = "string" }
cardinality = 256
annotations = { "freshness.ttl_s" = 900 }
contracts.knob.v1:
# core §7.5's owner heartbeat: W2's rfcfg.v1 in shape, one collection of
# one member, self-contained.
[interface]
name  = "knob"
major = 1
minor = 0
uses  = ["freshness.v2"]

[resources.config]                   # one member
kind        = "state"
type        = { raw = "text/plain" }
annotations = { "freshness.ttl_s" = 60 }
contracts.vital.v1:
# core §7.5's owner heartbeat: W2's health.v1 in shape, one collection of
# one member, self-contained.
[interface]
name  = "vital"
major = 1
minor = 0
uses  = ["freshness.v2"]

[resources.status]                   # one member
kind        = "state"
type        = { raw = "text/plain" }
annotations = { "freshness.ttl_s" = 60 }
